parameters.name: Decompress
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to identify and decompress compressed files. Valid values:
- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No.

parameters.name: DecompressMaxFileCount
parameters.description:
The maximum number of files to decompress. Maximum value: 1000.

This parameter is required when Decompress is set to true.

parameters.name: DecompressMaxLayer
parameters.description:
The maximum number of decompression layers when compressed files are nested within a compressed package. Maximum value: 5.

This parameter is required when Decompress is set to true.

parameters.name: DownloadUrl
parameters.description: The download URL of the file. You can pass in a download URL (public URL) to directly trigger file detection without uploading the file in advance.

parameters.name: HashKey
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the file. This parameter is required and must be the MD5 or SHA-256 hash of the file.

parameters.name: OssKey
parameters.description:
The storage key of the file in the OSS bucket.

If you push the file for detection by using DownloadUrl, this parameter is not required. You can obtain this parameter by calling the [CreateFileDetectUploadUrl](~~CreateFileDetectUploadUrl~~) operation.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of file to detect. Valid values:

- **0**: malicious file detection
